title: A Treatise on the Heavy Dark
summary: A treatise on packing darkness so densely that it presses on a foe like a weight and holds a stance under heavy blows.

title: The Lightless Field Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading dark qi round the body as a living field that swallows light and senses all that enters it.

title: Canon of the Gathering Dusk
summary: A canon on calling dusk down over a patch of ground and a group of foes until none can tell friend from stranger.

title: The Twin Dusk Compendium
summary: A compendium of darkness drawn from two sides at once so that two dim fronts close on one point and the foe is caught between.

title: The Hawk-Shadow Treatise
summary: A treatise on a shadow that rises on cool air and stoops from above like a hawk and strikes where the foe never looks up.

title: Manual of the Two-Court Dark
summary: A manual on keeping one court of dark for the strike and a second for the guard so that attack and defence run side by side.

title: The Wind-Sworn Shade Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of shade that a wind-sworn student carries on the breath and reads by the way it bends round others.

title: The Oath of the Unlit Bearing
summary: A sworn manual of darkness held on a fixed bearing that does not waver and is let go all at once at the end.

title: Manual of the Unwalled Dark
summary: A manual of dark thrown open along a clear bearing that offers no cover and no shelter to those whom it meets.
